notes.title: Patch Notes - 9/30
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New Dark Moon unit - Eye of Cthulu
[*] Active: Eye Beam - Deals massive magical damage in a line.
[*] Passive: Inflict Fear - Basic attacks reduce target's magic resistance by 10%.

[*] Changes to Dark Moon devotion - now causes dark moon units to gain double stats from items. 4/4
[*] Dark Moon units have all lost their sub type - instead, they can now equip any item unconditionally of sharing devotions.

[*] Various bug fixes, including an experimental fix that will hopefully fix a bug related to resurrection. This fix changes unit auto attack behaviour, so they no longer interrupt attack animation when their target dies.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 9/20
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a setting for adjusting camera movement speed.
[*] Increased camera height threshold for control zoom.
[*] Hovering attack range in setup phase now has a visual.
[*] Fixed various bugs related to targeting, including shadowstep targetting for assassins and other abilities.
[*] Deadshot -> Tier 2
[*] Deathcap -> Tier 1
[*] Nerfed Deadshot active ability mana cost, 60 -> 100.
[*] Adjusted damage and attack range on these two archer units.
[*] Carnivorous plant buffed health and damage on thorns from 70% -> 100%.
[*] Lone wolf damage nerfed from 80 -> 40.
[*] Monument treeline adjustments.
[*] Various item adjustments and bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 9/18
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug related to resurrection.
- A handful of minor text fixes.

notes.title: Update Notes - 9/17
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a new zoom out feature. By holding control while scrolling, you are now able to move the camera up and see more of the map.
[*] Fixed a couple of major bugs relating to dragging units on/off the bench.
[*] Fixed a variety of other minor bugs.
[*] More robust logging for finding and submitting future bug reports.
[/list]
